evidence_limits.occlusion_risk: A2 produces no occlusion estimate. oracle_context_gate uses forbidden TEST scenario metadata only as an upper-bound diagnostic.
evidence_limits.rate_streams: Captured rate streams contain repeated frames at one simulator time; they test deterministic persistence, not changing-scene safety.
evidence_limits.space_visibility: A2 produces vehicle boxes only; it has no independent visible-empty-space evidence.
evidence_limits.temporal_3_and_5_test: Not estimable for OPEN recall on frozen TEST: no TEST sequence contains 3 or 5 genuine consecutive frames.
evidence_limits.transition_state: A2 produces no transition state. The TEST split has only two same-lighting transition positions and no settled temporal sequences.

demo_rate_streams.note: Cached duplicate frames retain the latency of their first inference.

demo_scenes.note: Cached duplicate frames retain the latency of their first inference.

test.note: Cached duplicate frames retain the latency of their first inference.

policy_definitions.any_overlap_veto: Naive policy plus abstain when any A2 detection at the 0.05 model floor intersects the ROI.
policy_definitions.current: OCCUPIED at confidence >=0.65 and ROI coverage >=0.45; otherwise UNCERTAIN; OPEN disabled.
policy_definitions.low_floor_space_veto: Naive policy plus abstain when any A2 detection has confidence >=0.05 and ROI coverage >=0.02.
policy_definitions.naive_absence: OCCUPIED at production gates; otherwise OPEN when frame and ROI quality pass.
policy_definitions.oracle_context_gate: Low-floor veto plus TEST-only ground-truth gates excluding transitions and scenarios with occluders; not deployable.
policy_definitions.temporal_2: Two adjacent low-floor-veto OPEN candidates in a genuine same-scene sequence.
policy_definitions.temporal_3: Three adjacent low-floor-veto OPEN candidates in a genuine same-scene sequence.
policy_definitions.temporal_5: Five adjacent low-floor-veto OPEN candidates in a genuine same-scene sequence.
policy_definitions.whole_frame_clear: Naive policy but OPEN only when A2 emits no detection anywhere in the valid frame.

smallest_next_engineering_change: Add and validate camera-specific positive empty-space/visibility evidence (including an occlusion/transition gate), then collect a new sealed multi-frame held-out set with at least five consecutive frames per settled and transition scene.
